out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at hand sink in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels during inspection. BURRITOS BROSS - CAMBA CAFE (Inspection Date: 08/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw ground beef, raw shell egg above ready to eat foods in 2 door upright.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS discussed proper raw storage. PIC relocated raw items to bottom shelf of unit. Please train all staff on proper raw storage and ensure continuous compliance.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed rice pudding (51F), flan (52F) at 1 door upright display near register.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed ibuprofen stored in food preparation area in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Item relocated away from food preparation area. Please ensure continuous compliance and ensure medications are stored in designated areas away from food preparation areas.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, Health Department Determines Need
violations.observation: Specialized processing method of food preservation used for dulce de leche made on site. Observed facility jarring dulce de leche.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1. smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2. curing food, 3. using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4. packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5. operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6. custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7. preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regularty Authority to require a variance or, 8. sprouting seeds or beans. PIC agreed to discontinue jarring process and discarded products.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: retail shopping bags used to store shredded cheese.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC discarded shopping bags during inspection.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection. Observed no certified food manager at the start of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Certified food manager arrived during inspection. Please ensure there is a certified food manager at all times during food preparation or sale.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: observed yucca and cheese dish with no end point.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC provided date and time marking for items prepared within 4 hours.
